action: Sekurak advises deleting the downloaded files without running the installer; if it was run, disconnect the device from the network, scan it for malware, and change passwords and log out active sessions.
date_note: Date of the Sekurak article; the page gives no earlier day for the campaign report
exec: Fake GTA VI launchers for Windows are being offered on many domains and subdomains, per Vecert Foundation as relayed by Sekurak.
geo_basis: no victim or place stated; global lure
plain: Criminals offer fake GTA VI installers for Windows PCs. Researchers from Vecert Foundation, cited by Sekurak, found many domains and subdomains spreading malware, though the game has no PC version.
summary: Sekurak, summarising research by the Vecert Foundation, reports that criminals offer fake GTA VI launchers for Windows PCs, since the game has no PC version. Vecert Foundation researchers found many domains and subdomains distributing malware in a campaign they call CyberLeek. According to Sekurak, the researchers did not identify a specific malware family.
title: Vecert Foundation reports a CyberLeek campaign of fake GTA VI PC installers, Sekurak says

validation.note: Only Sekurak read; the Vecert Foundation report itself was not found or read.
